design_detail: 0.5% on net wealth of 3 to 5 million dinars, 1% above 5 million dinars; annual, on immovable and movable property of individuals, main residence and bank deposits exempt (PLF 2026, article 50)
quote_original: توسيع مجال تطبيق الضريبة على الثروة واعتماد نظام ضريبة تصاعدية
quote_en: extend the application of the wealth tax and adopt a progressive tax system
source_title: Minutes of the finance and budget committee, 11 November 2025 (hearing of the Minister of Finance)
grading_note: The Finance Minister presented the government bill to the committee: extend the wealth tax with progressive rates of 0.5% and 1%. Government bill with rates and threshold (A). Quote checked by hand in the PDF text.

design_detail: 0.5% on net wealth of 3 to 5 million dinars, 1% above 5 million dinars; annual, on immovable and movable property of individuals, main residence and bank deposits exempt
quote_original: l’impôt sur la fortune s’explique, par ailleurs, par l’annonce officielle de la ministre des Finances, Mechkat Salama Khaldi, qui a indiqué qu’elle présenterait une version entièrement révisée du texte
quote_en: the wealth tax rejection is explained by the Finance Minister Mechkat Salama Khaldi's official announcement that she would present an entirely revised version of the text
source_title: Le Parlement rejette à nouveau l’article sur l’impôt sur la fortune en plénière
grading_note: The minister announced a revised article after the plenary rejection (she re-tabled it on 4 December). The outlet reports the announcement by the committee chair, so B.

design_detail: 0.5% on net wealth of 3 to 5 million dinars, 1% above 5 million dinars; annual, on immovable and movable property of individuals, main residence and bank deposits exempt; adopted 72 for, 14 against, 16 abstentions
quote_original: L’article a été adopté avec 72 voix pour, 14 voix contre et 16 absentions.
quote_en: The article was adopted with 72 votes for, 14 against and 16 abstentions.
source_title: Loi de Finances 2026 : l’ARP adopte le texte final et valide l’impôt sur la fortune
grading_note: Chamber passed the wealth tax article (formal act, A). The plenary result is published as a count; no per-member list was found, so no deputy is recorded from it.

design_detail: 0.5% on net wealth of 3 to 5 million dinars, 1% above 5 million dinars; annual, on immovable and movable property of individuals, main residence and bank deposits exempt
quote_original: صادق مجلس نواب الشعب اليوم على فصل إضافي من مشروع قانون المالية لسنة 2026 يتعلق بـ"الضريبة على الثروة"
quote_en: The House of the People's Representatives today approved an additional article of the 2026 finance bill on the "wealth tax"
source_title: مجلس نواب الشعب يصادق على فرض ضريبة على الثروة
grading_note: Same plenary vote reported by a second outlet (72 for, 16 abstentions, 14 against).

design_detail: Finance committee approved article 50 with two amendments: bank and post-office deposits excluded; rates 0.5% (2 to 3 million dinars) and 1% (above 3 million dinars)
quote_original: le Conseil national avait émis un avis consultatif favorable à la disposition fiscale
quote_en: the National Council had issued a favourable consultative opinion on the tax provision
source_title: Bras de fer autour de l’impôt sur la fortune : l’ARP dit non, le Conseil national dit oui
grading_note: Consultative favourable opinion of the second chamber, stated by an opponent in the article; B because it is consultative and committee-level.

design_detail: Keep article 50 in amended form at the plenary
quote_original: Slim Salem, a insisté sur le fait que son instance maintiendra l’article 50 sous sa forme amendée lors de la séance plénière
quote_en: Slim Salem insisted that his body will keep article 50 in its amended form at the plenary session
source_title: Bras de fer autour de l’impôt sur la fortune : l’ARP dit non, le Conseil national dit oui
grading_note: Journalist narrates the committee chair's stand; B.

design_detail: Defends article 50 (the wealth tax), which his committee amended to widen the base to movable and immovable property
quote_original: élargissant la base de la taxation sur les biens immobiliers et mobiliers à 0,5 % pour les fortunes comprises entre deux et trois millions de dinars
quote_en: widening the base of the tax on immovable and movable property to 0.5% for fortunes between two and three million dinars
source_title: Bras de fer autour de l’impôt sur la fortune : l’ARP dit non, le Conseil national dit oui
grading_note: The CNRD finance committee vice-chair defends the article and describes its amendments to the wealth tax, saying "l’article 50 n’a pas été rejeté"; narrated by the outlet (B).

design_detail: Asked for the plenary to decide on article 50 after committee rejection
quote_original: l’impôt sur la fortune n’est « pas une innovation tunisienne » et qu’il est en vigueur dans plusieurs pays
quote_en: the wealth tax is "not a Tunisian innovation" and is in force in several countries
source_title: Bras de fer autour de l’impôt sur la fortune : l’ARP dit non, le Conseil national dit oui
grading_note: The rapporteur defended the tax and regretted its rejection; narrated by the outlet (B).

design_detail: Bloc to propose raising the rates: 0.5% to 1% for 3 to 5 million dinars, 1% to 3% above 5 million
quote_original: estimant que les grandes fortunes doivent contribuer davantage
quote_en: holding that the large fortunes should contribute more
source_title: Impôt sur la fortune : le bloc “Pour que le peuple triomphe” veut rétablir l’article 50
grading_note: Deputy of the bloc, on Diwan FM: the bloc did not back the deletion of article 50 (the wealth tax) and wants the large fortunes to contribute more; narrated by the outlet (B).

design_detail: Amendment to reinstate article 50 with rates of 0.5% to 1% for 3 to 5 million dinars and 1% to 3% above 5 million
quote_original: Le bloc “Pour que le peuple triomphe” entend présenter un amendement durcissant les taux de l’impôt sur la fortune
quote_en: The bloc "Pour que le peuple triomphe" intends to present an amendment raising the wealth tax rates
source_title: Impôt sur la fortune : le bloc “Pour que le peuple triomphe” veut rétablir l’article 50
grading_note: Parliamentary bloc announces an amendment with named rates; the amendment was announced, not seen filed (A for the specifics).

design_detail: Reintroduce and strengthen the progressivity of the 0.5% and 1% wealth tax tranches
quote_original: l’Observatoire souligne que l’adoption d’un impôt progressif sur la fortune est essentielle pour une redistribution équitable
quote_en: the Observatory stresses that adopting a progressive wealth tax is essential for fair redistribution
source_title: Tunisie | Pourquoi l’impôt sur la fortune est nécessaire
grading_note: Communiqué of 1 December 2025 calling on parliamentarians to reinstate and strengthen the tax; names tranches (A).

design_detail: Calls for a stronger progressivity of the wealth tax
quote_original: Le rejet de l’article 50 par la commission fait suite aux appels de l’OTE et du Centre Ali Ben Ghedhahem pour la justice fiscale en faveur d’un renforcement de la progressivité de l’impôt sur la fortune
quote_en: The committee's rejection of article 50 follows the calls of the OTE and the Ali Ben Ghedhahem Centre for fiscal justice to strengthen the progressivity of the wealth tax
source_title: Tunisie | Pourquoi l’impôt sur la fortune est nécessaire
grading_note: Reported by a third party and dated at the article; the earlier calls themselves were not found on the Centre's own site (B).

design_detail: Wealth tax on the richest 10%, covering all immovable and financial assets, progressive with a higher rate on the richest 1%
quote_original: est l’institution d’un impôt sur les grandes fortunes
quote_en: the institution of a tax on large fortunes
source_title: La justice fiscale, un enjeu de survie à la portée de la Tunisie
grading_note: Author of a report recommending the tax with its design (A). Publication month taken from the file path of the upload.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the richest 10%, progressive
quote_original: est l’institution d’un impôt sur les grandes fortunes
quote_en: the institution of a tax on large fortunes
source_title: La justice fiscale, un enjeu de survie à la portée de la Tunisie
grading_note: Published the report on its own site; the proposal is the author's (B).

design_detail: 5% wealth tax on fortunes of US$5m and above across Egypt, Lebanon, Morocco and Tunisia
quote_original: a 5% wealth tax on individuals with fortunes of US$5m and above would generate a combined US$10bn revenue
source_title: The Middle East and North Africa Gap: Prosperity for the rich, austerity for the rest
grading_note: Four-country report that covers Tunisia and its 0.5% net wealth tax; the recommendation is regional, not Tunisia-specific (B).

design_detail: Proposes a 1% annual tax on capital (wealth) as the way for each to contribute according to means
quote_original: La contribution de chacun selon ses moyens passe donc par la mise en place d’un impôt sur la fortune ou, de manière plus neutre, sur le capital.
quote_en: The contribution of each according to his means therefore requires an annual wealth tax or, more neutrally, a tax on capital.
source_title: Elyès Jouini: Vers une fiscalité plus équitable: l'impôt progressif sur la fortune
grading_note: Signed op-ed by the economist recommending a wealth tax and giving the rate (1%) (A). Dated 1 October 2014 on the page.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the highest fortunes; a 0.5% rate is given as an example
quote_original: la mise en place d’un impôt sur le patrimoine pour les patrimoines les plus élevés à l’instar de nombreux pays
quote_en: the introduction of a wealth tax for the highest fortunes, as in many countries
source_title: Elyès Jouini, universitaire et ancien ministre : «Lutter contre l’économie de rente, ce n’est pas lutter contre les grandes entreprises»
grading_note: Interview answer in his own words, with a 0.5% example rate on fortunes of several million dinars (A).

design_detail: Wealth tax (ISF) to raise revenue and make the system fairer, with conditions
quote_original: La mise en place d’un impôt sur la fortune (ISF) serait donc une vraie niche pour améliorer les recettes fiscales tout en rendant le système plus équitable.
quote_en: Introducing a wealth tax (ISF) would therefore be a real niche for improving tax revenue while making the system fairer.
source_title: Impôt : Oui pour taxer les fortunes, mais intelligemment
grading_note: Editorial under the headline "Oui pour taxer les fortunes, mais intelligemment": names the wealth tax, adds conditions (B).

design_detail: Solidarity wealth tax among proposals for fiscal justice
quote_original: Taxer le patrimoine et mettre en place un impôt de solidarité sur la fortune.
quote_en: Tax wealth and introduce a solidarity tax on fortunes.
source_title: La Tunisie, de « l’enfer fiscal » à la justice sociale
grading_note: Signed opinion piece ("nous proposons") listing a solidarity wealth tax among its measures; no rate (B).

design_detail: Joint committees voted on two amendments; the amended article was accepted by the CNRD finance committee and not by the ARP finance committee
quote_original: في حين تم قبوله من قبل أعضاء لجنة المالية والميزانية للمجلس الوطني للجهات والأقاليم
quote_en: whereas it was accepted by the members of the finance and budget committee of the National Council of Regions and Districts
source_title: Minutes of the joint finance committees, 21 November 2025 (examination of article 50)
grading_note: Official minutes: the finance committee of the CNRD accepted article 50 as amended, while the ARP finance committee did not. A committee vote, not a plenary of the chamber, but a formal act (A).
